opportunities.name: Hotel search, currency conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a city for given dates, convert its price from EUR to a target currency on Xe, and draft an email to a contact proposing the hotel.
steps: On Booking.com enter destination and select check-in/check-out dates, then Search
Open the top hotel result and note name and price
On Xe converter enter the EUR price in the amount field and set target currency
Open mail new message, enter recipient, subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>'
Type body with hotel, EUR price, converted amount; click Discard/Send

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR->USD, maria
Milan, Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR->JPY, kenji
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15, Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR->GBP, aisha

opportunities.name: City weather and news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day forecast on the weather site, search BBC for city strike news, and email a contact a weather and headline summary.
steps: On weather site open location search, type city, select result
Open 10 Day tab and note forecast
Open BBC search, type '<city> strike', Enter
Open top article and note headline and date
Open mail new message, enter recipient, subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'
Type body with temps, conditions, headline; Discard/Send

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up a nationality's visa requirements on Wikipedia, find the destination country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and open it
Find destination country's entry for visa and allowed stay
On timeanddate open Holidays and search/click destination country
In Notes add a note summarizing visa and holidays
